title: Arriving late for the first Savoy night: 'Western Dogs'
summary: The band's cars broke down, they arrived hours late, and Buchanan made them play all night, outswinging Lucky Millinder and being called Western Dogs.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: When we came to New York, we were late getting there. We were supposed to have been there at 5:00 that evening, to open up.
At the Savoy.
At the Savoy. When we got there, it was around -- almost 9:00. Lucky Millinder was playing. He was on the stand, he had stayed there because we wasn't there.
Yeah. So they were salty, huh?
And we didn't know whether we were going to play or not, because we were late, see.
Yeah. And for the first time in New York. For all of you.
The first time in New York. Everybody was mad with us, see. So we got up there on the stand, you know, and started playing, when we got up there. And Buchanan,

he was mad, and he's rolling his eyes. When we started playing, the floor started jumping, it was jitterbugs and everything. They was swinging back, and Lucky Millinder was on the other end and he was playing all types of tunes, trying to -- a fast one and slow one --
Try to find that --

Trying to find that beat. And we stayed in one tempo, all night long. And when we finally got intermission, Buchanan called us over and just ate us out. And he was thinking about letting us go, but he said, 'You get back on that stand and don't you come off, till it's time to close.' And we had to play all the way through when we got there. And we played and they started jumping. Kept that same tempo. But we outswung everything that was up there that day.
Yeah.
We were afraid. We were afraid, you know.
Yeah, well, all you have to do is really flop once --

We didn't change clothes. We come around with -- had on these clothes. We didn't get a chance to change into uniforms and all. We didn't have that blue coat and brown pants or something, whatever it was. But we just got up there like we were and played.
Yeah.
See, the cars broke down, so that made us the reason we was late.
Well, those things happen and it isn't anybody's fault.
Yeah, but we should have been there.
Yeah.
One of those things.
And, I mean, --
We had to buy new tires. John Ventura had retreads on one of the tires, and they all blew off, and we had to buy new tires. And -- we were just late.
Coming into New York for the first time.
First time in New York. And Lucky Millinder and those guys called us the Western Dogs. And we swung them off the stage.

Jay made me laugh because he said that Buchanan is such a -- maybe not that night, but the night after or something, said to Lucky, 'Come on, and I'll introduce you to McShann or something.' Lucky said,--
He didn't want to meet him.
Forget it, or something. 'I can meet a guy like that any time. I'll see him tonight, or something. And that the band swung them right off the stand.' And Lucky
McShann "You come out with me."
(Laughter.)
Lucky was jumping all over the stand. He was a good front man.
Yeah. He was a good conductor...
Good front man.
Because he had that smile on his face, and -- He jumped down off

with his little box in front of the bandstand and waving his hands. And the band was swinging, but we were afraid, and we just had to do something. And everybody was glad when we got back on the stand, because Lucky was playing the fast ones and everything. So when we did start playing fast tunes, that was it.
Yeah.
See, but we kept just a good bounce all the time.
Yeah.
Good bounce. Just the jump just going.
That's right, just a good jump.
Yeah, yeah.
And the musicians, they all came over to us. They was glad to meet us, one of those things.
Yeah, yeah.
"What happened? How come you was late?"
And we told them. " The tires blew out, we almost had to put a new motor in and all like that.
Yeah.
Which we did. And that's the way it was.
The Western Dogs.
Yeah, called us the Western Dogs, yeah. These Western dogs coming in here, --
(End of Side One.)
